definition: a contagious viral infection that brings fever, aching and exhaustion
hook: Every winter you catch a disease that is named after astrology.
modernAnchor: A fever, aching legs, three days lost under a blanket. We call it influenza, or just the flu.
journey: Medieval astrologers believed an invisible fluid flowed down from the stars and into people. That flowing in was called an influence.
When a sickness swept through a whole city at once, no one could see a cause. So Italians blamed the sky and called the outbreak an influenza.
In 1743 an epidemic spread out of Italy across Europe, and English newspapers carried the Italian name along with the news.
Within a century English had clipped it to flu. The stars were cleared of the charge, but their name is still on the diagnosis.
